_doc: Continuous journey, schema 2. Chapters and explicit prerequisites describe a story, never the current loaded region. Objective world/worlds scopes evidence, not visibility. level is a recommendation, not an unlock. Existing quest ids, primary counts and numeric rewards are retained for v7 saves. Completed historical records never pay again. Unlisted historical definitions are archived, not activated.
